tshedy.definition: A prepared material; subtype moist-preparation for this declared tuple, not identical to its liquid component.

sheocphy.definition: A deposited material residue; no purity, medicinal efficacy or extraction result encoded.

pcheody.definition: Orders the preceding resolved episode before the following episode.

opchear.definition: Keep the specified material available; no filtering or removal.

opchedy.definition: Gentle manner of the action; no application or mixing meaning.

otal.definition: A covered state of a material; no cover action, cover identity, vessel or seal supplied.

daiin.definition: A material portion relative to a carrier. Quantity, size, event and carrier identity require grammar; identical value at both occurrences.

sheor.definition: Dry material condition; no drying action.

qoteey.definition: Keep a material in storage; no vessel, period or patient supplied.

okchedy.definition: Moist material condition; not the inherited whole moist-preparation noun.

sheos.definition: Expose a material to a medium; no guarantee of drying or efficacy.

aiin.definition: Air as a medium/material. No duration, quantity, botanical taxon or season.
